_meta.dataset: What the published sources actually say about indoor light
_meta.description: 562 figures and statements about houseplant light, humidity, temperature and airflow, transcribed one by one from 81 publishers — university extension services, botanical gardens, veterinary schools, poison centres, national laboratories and peer-reviewed papers. Units are left exactly as each source writes them and nothing is converted. Every row links to the page it was read on. The point of the collection is not agreement: the same plant is given a 40 °F floor by one extension service and 60 °F by another, and "low light" starts at 25, 75 or 100 foot-candles depending on who you ask.
_meta.license_compilation: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) — applies to this compilation: which sources were read, how the rows are structured, and the links.
_meta.license_quotes: Each quoted sentence remains the property of the publisher named in its row. Quotes are short excerpts reproduced for identification, each with a link to the original page.
